test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A - B means ‘A is the wife of B’;

A + B means ‘A is the sister of B’ and

A * B means ‘A is the father of B’.

If Q - T * Y + M - K, then how is Q related to K?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 -
 +
 *
 
 

 Meaning
 Wife
 Sister
 Father
 
 

 

Given: Q - T * Y + M - K

It means: Q is the Wife of T, T is the Father of Y, Y is the Sister of M, M is the Wife of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e939217a8c0000fedd3060ad34c55a2ce05abf8f6097ab280fdb84eb0cb88a66.png] 

So, Q is the '**Mother-in-law**' of K.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
